text:
Eli Brown: Quick travel/expense question — rented an EV for a customer offsite last week. Can we expense: 1) charging station fees (ChargePoint, EVgo receipts), 2) toll transponder charges (EZ-Pass style), and 3) one overnight I added for personal reasons (how to split)?

Maya Chen: Short answer: yes for 1 & 2 if business-related and you have receipts. Personal overnight needs a split. See below for what to attach. @Priya-S

Priya Singh: Details:
- Charging + tolls: reimbursable as ground transportation. Must attach itemized receipts or provider email receipts that show date, location/transaction, and amount. We can accept PDF/email receipts, ChargePoint screenshots, or the station's emailed receipt.
- Rental car insurance/damage waivers: if you bought CDW on the rental, we prefer the company card; if on personal card, include justification and we’ll review.
- Personal overnight: anything clearly personal (extra hotel night, minibar, etc.) must be subtracted. On the expense, add a line like `Personal portion: -$XX` and include a short note explaining nights/dates.

Priya Singh: Example expense note you can paste into the form:  ```
Expense category: Ground Transportation > Rental Car - EV
Total rental (card): $342.00
Charging station fees: $23.40 (ChargePoint 2026-03-10)
Tolls: $12.50 (transponder 2026-03-11)
Personal overnight deduction: -$85.00 (personal night 2026-03-12)
Business total requested: $292.90
Receipt(s): attached - rental agreement, ChargePoint email, toll statement, hotel folio
Purpose: Customer offsite — product demo and partner meetings (2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12)
```

Trey (FinanceBot): Quick process notes: forward any provider receipt emails to expenses@redwood.com with your name + expense date in the subject to auto-attach. If you scanned multiple receipts into one PDF, add short captions (e.g., `ChargePoint 3/10 - $8.20`). Use category code `GT-RC-EV` in the dropdown to help tagging.

Eli Brown: Awesome — thanks. One more: my ChargePoint email only shows session ID, not location address. Is that ok?

Maya Chen: That's okay if it includes date/time and amount. If location missing, add a one-line note with address or station name (you can find it in the app). If finance needs more, they’ll ping you. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: If the personal night was >50% of trip days we may ask for more context, but for a single extra night this is fine with the split. Submit within 30 days to avoid delays.

Eli Brown: Filing now — thanks all! :pray:
